intro: A spouse visa UK application lets you live here with your husband, wife or civil partner who is British or settled. We help you choose the right partner route, meet the financial requirement and build strong relationship evidence.

purposesTitle: Which spouse visa UK route fits you?
purposesIntro: All partner routes sit under Appendix FM of the Immigration Rules.

purposes.title: Spouse or civil partner
purposes.text: For married couples and civil partners.

purposes.title: Unmarried partner
purposes.text: For couples who have lived together for at least 2 years.

purposes.title: Fiancé(e) visa
purposes.text: For couples marrying in the UK within 6 months of arriving.

purposes.title: Extension
purposes.text: To extend after your first grant, towards settlement.

rules.title: The financial requirement
rules.text: Most new applications need £29,000 a year, from employment, self-employment, pension or savings. Savings above £16,000 can make up a shortfall. Some sponsors who receive certain benefits are exempt. [Read our financial requirement guide](/spouse-visa-financial-requirement/)

rules.title: English language
rules.text: You need A1 for a first application, A2 when you extend and B1 for settlement, unless you are exempt. [Read our English language guide](/english-language-requirement/)

rules.title: Your route to settlement
rules.text: Partners of British citizens keep a 5-year route to Indefinite Leave to Remain under the government’s plans. [Read about the ILR changes](/ilr-changes-2026/)

rules.title: Don’t overstay
rules.text: If you are already in the UK, you must apply before your current permission ends. Get advice early if your visa is running out.

boxTitle: Want a second pair of eyes before you apply?
boxText: A consultation costs far less than a refused application. We’ll check your case against the current rules and tell you honestly where you stand.

sections.heading: Spouse visa UK requirements in detail
sections.text: Your partner must be British, Irish, settled in the UK, or have refugee status or humanitarian protection. You must both be 18 or over, intend to live together permanently in the UK, and show that your relationship is genuine and continuing. You also need to meet the financial, English language and accommodation requirements.

sections.heading: How long does a spouse visa UK application take?
sections.text: Applications from outside the UK are usually decided within about 12 weeks, and in-country applications within about 8 weeks, though times vary. Priority services can be available for an extra fee.

sections.heading: After your spouse visa
sections.text: You extend your visa after your first grant, then apply for Indefinite Leave to Remain when you qualify, and later British citizenship if you wish. We can help at each stage and check your [time outside the UK](/absence-calculator/) before you apply.

faqs.q: How much do I need to earn for a spouse visa UK?
faqs.a: Most new applications need £29,000 a year. You can use employment, self-employment, pension income or savings, and in some cases combine them.

faqs.q: Can my savings count towards a spouse visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Savings above £16,000 can be used to make up a shortfall in income, using a set formula.

faqs.q: Can I work on a spouse visa?
faqs.a: Yes. You can work and study in the UK on a spouse or partner visa.
